feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 May 2026 4:14pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 08 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Low to the north of Scotland, slowly moving into the Norwegian Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly northerly 3 or 4, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area at first, occasionally reaching force 5 in the west of the area this evening, then increasing north or northeast 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the west overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight occasionally moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northeast 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the west at first, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight, backing northwest on Sunday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate, falling smooth or slight on Sunday morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
